chocographs.name: Between Mountains
chocographs.treasureLocation: Eunorus Plains coast, north-west of Lindblum

chocographs.name: Uncultivated Land
chocographs.treasureLocation: Marshy patch on the east bank of the river north of Treno, just east of the Evil Forest (Zamo Basin)
chocographs.treasureTracks: Tracks in Zamo Basin beside the marsh, reachable only by airship; with the Mountain ability, tracks on King Ed Plains or Edgecry Coast work too
chocographs.treasureNote: Needs an airship (Disc 3) or the Mountain ability. No special ability is needed to dig.
chocographs.reward: 10 Antidote, Jade Armlet, 3 Wing Edge, Cargo Ship Card

chocographs.treasureNote: Needs a ship or airship to reach the Lost Continent.
chocographs.reward: 5 Echo Screen, 7 Hi-Potion, 3 Tent, Theater Ship Card

chocographs.treasureLocation: Reef off the north-west Forgotten Continent

chocographs.reward: 37 Potion, 6 Magic Tag, Shield Armor, Gaia Gear
